premise: It's Maya's birthday and there's nothing to wrap on the Moon, so in the long night Leo switches on every grow light and the greenhouse glows like a lantern — just as a comet crosses the sky.
inspiration: O. Henry's 'The Gift of the Magi', where two people give up their treasures for each other, turned: nobody gives anything up — the gift is light.
lesson: The best presents are the ones made with care.

en-US.title: A Lantern for Maya
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} It was Maya's birthday, deep in the long Moon night. {man:enter} Leo had a problem. {man:face sad} [sighs] There are no shops on the Moon. No wrapping paper. No ribbon. Nothing to wrap at all. {man:live} {sfx:beep} He checked his wrist. He checked it again. Then {man:face happy} he had an idea. The {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse sat dark and quiet on the plain. {man:go to greenhouse} Leo loped over and switched on every grow light at once. {greenhouse:live hold} {sfx:click} Click! The whole dome lit up, glowing green and gold, like a giant lantern. {man:hop} Inside, the {seedling:enter} seedling woke in its dome and {seedling:live} stretched up toward the light. Just then, {woman:enter} Maya came loping home across the dark plain. {woman:face surprised} [gasps] {woman:shake 0.3} She stopped. {canvas:comet 0.6 14s} And high above, as if it knew, a comet came sailing across the stars. {woman:says} [in awe] “Leo… did you order a comet too?” {man:says} [laughs] “I wish! Happy birthday, Maya.” {woman:face happy} {woman:hearts} {man:hearts} [happily] It was the brightest birthday on the Moon.

es-ES.title: Un farol para Maya
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} Era el cumpleaños de Maya, en plena noche lunar. {man:enter} Leo tenía un problema. {man:face sad} [sighs] En la Luna no hay tiendas. Ni papel de regalo. Ni lazos. Nada que envolver. {man:live} {sfx:beep} Miró su muñeca. Volvió a mirarla. Y entonces {man:face happy} se le ocurrió una idea. El {greenhouse:enter} invernadero estaba oscuro y en silencio en la llanura. {man:go to greenhouse} Leo fue dando saltos y encendió todas las luces a la vez. {greenhouse:live hold} {sfx:click} ¡Clic! La cúpula entera se iluminó, verde y dorada, como un farol gigante. {man:hop} Dentro, el {seedling:enter} brote se despertó en su cúpula y {seedling:live} se estiró hacia la luz. Justo entonces, {woman:enter} Maya volvía a casa dando saltos por la llanura oscura. {woman:face surprised} [gasps] {woman:shake 0.3} Se paró en seco. {canvas:comet 0.6 14s} Y muy alto, como si lo supiera, un cometa cruzó entre las estrellas. {woman:says} [in awe] «Leo… ¿también has pedido un cometa?» {man:says} [laughs] «¡Ojalá! Feliz cumpleaños, Maya.» {woman:face happy} {woman:hearts} {man:hearts} [happily] Fue el cumpleaños más luminoso de la Luna.

beep.prompt: two short soft electronic beeps from a small wrist computer

click.prompt: a soft click of a big switch, followed by the gentle hum of lights warming up
